entities.name: William V, Duke of Aquitaine
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William the Great was duke of Aquitaine and count of Poitou from 990 until his death. Upon the death of the emperor Henry II, he was offered the kingdom of Italy but declined to contest the title against Conrad II.
